## fc8c7392a146

Concrete validator and override gap: the summary/invariants require body shapes
of size 3–7 (3–5 in the prose), but `self_check` only counts components. It
accepts this grid with `[]`, although both body shapes are single cells:

```text
12000
00000
10020
00000
00000
```

The declared `shape_size` override is also ignored. With
`shape_size=7, n_legend=2`, seeds 0..4 produced body-size pairs
`[5,5]`, `[5,5]`, `[3,3]`, `[6,4]`, and `[3,4]`. This means override tests or a
strict semantic hook can claim a requested shape-size curriculum that the input
does not realize. The generator should consume `shape_size`, expose an observer,
and have `self_check` enforce each body component's cell count and row-1/body
separation.

triage.reason: Both source-bound finding sections retained for future task owners. Local main-generator checks do not independently reproduce these audits. See REVIEW/intake-20261002-batch12.json.
